record.original_question: Use Dulac functions to produce proofs that the classical Lienard bounds Lie(3)=1 and Lie(4)=1 hold for polynomial Lienard systems x' = y - F(x), y' = -x.

evidence.quote: Problem 4. Find a proof using Dulac functions that Lie(3) = 1 and Lie(4) = 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the polynomial Liénard system in the plane
$$x' = y - F(x), \qquad y' = -x,$$
where $F(x)$ is a real polynomial of degree $n$ with $F(0)=0$. For an integer $n\ge 1$, let $\mathrm{Lie}(n)$ denote the maximum number of limit cycles that such a system can have, taken over all polynomials $F$ of degree at most $n$. It is classically known that $\mathrm{Lie}(3) = 1$ and $\mathrm{Lie}(4) = 1$.

Recall that a Dulac function for a planar vector field $X = (P,Q)$ on a simply connected region $U \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ is a $C^1$ function $B: U \to \mathbb{R}$ such that the divergence
$$\operatorname{div}(BX) = \frac{\partial (BP)}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial (BQ)}{\partial y}$$
does not change sign and is not identically zero on $U$; the existence of such a $B$ on an annular region precludes more than one limit cycle there (Bendixson–Dulac theorem and its annular generalization).

Problem: Produce explicit Dulac functions (or Dulac–Cherkas functions) and an accompanying argument that proves $\mathrm{Lie}(3) = 1$ and $\mathrm{Lie}(4) = 1$ for the above polynomial Liénard family.
artifact.status_search_result: While the bounds Lie(3)=1 and Lie(4)=1 for polynomial Liénard systems are classical (Lins–de Melo–Pugh, Rychkov), the specific request for proofs via Dulac (or Dulac–Cherkas) functions appears to be an active line of research. Work on Dulac–Cherkas functions for generalized Liénard systems (e.g., Cherkas, Grin, Schneider) provides general machinery, but no widely cited paper unambiguously verifies that explicit Dulac-function proofs of Lie(3)=1 and Lie(4)=1 have been given. Status could not be conclusively determined from available sources.

status_evidence.title: Dulac-Cherkas functions for generalized Liénard systems
status_evidence.snippet: A method can be constructed for special classes of Dulac-Cherkas functions for generalized Liénard systems...
status_evidence.claim: General Dulac–Cherkas function machinery exists for Liénard-type systems but specific proofs of Lie(3)=1 and Lie(4)=1 are not directly stated.

status_evidence.title: Effectiveness of the Bendixson–Dulac theorem
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the effectiveness of Bendixson–Dulac type theorems for bounding the number of limit cycles.
status_evidence.claim: Effectiveness of Dulac-type methods for limit cycle bounds is an ongoing research topic.
